fields.text: FDA approval of Zepbound for OSA requires obesity (BMI ≥30 kg/m²). SURMOUNT-OSA mean BMI was 38.8 kg/m². The OSA-obesity indication is distinct from the weight management indication.

SURMOUNT-OSA excluded patients with T2DM. The Zepbound OSA indication is specifically for patients WITHOUT T2DM. Patients with T2DM and OSA who need GIP/GLP-1 therapy should use Mounjaro (tirzepatide for T2DM) — a separate indication.
